summary: v11.0.8.06 Enterprise Web Release: Eliminate Runtime Syntax Errors in ReturnsController, PurchaseController & ButtonIconEnhancer; Restore Returns Register Live Data & Create Return Modal Line Loading
highlights: 1. ReturnsController Syntax Restoration: Resolved misplaced isolateReturn function that prematurely truncated sendEmailPrompt and caused an invalid await SyntaxError, restoring window.ReturnsController and all return actions across the application.

2. PurchaseController Variable Redeclaration Fix: Renamed duplicate approvalBox declaration in showPurchaseDrawer to drawerApprovalBox, restoring PurchaseController initialization and eliminate all syntax failures.
3. ButtonIconEnhancer Regex Group Completion: Fixed unterminated regex capture group in EMOJI_REGEX, restoring ButtonIconEnhancer without crashing startup scripts.

4. Live Sales & Purchase Return Registers: Replaced static empty placeholders with live loading states, added automated inline img DOM mount triggers, and linked NavigationRouter/app.js boot lifecycle for instantaneous data rendering.

5. Create Return Modal Line Item Population: Restored synchronous options pre-population from active sales cache, enabled automatic return date formatting via DatePickerFormatter, and guaranteed item line preloading on modal launch.
